title: The MetLife Federal Dental Plan 2026 — A Nationwide Dental PPO Plan (FEDVIP brochure, OPM form 02AP-11)
publisher: U.S. Office of Personnel Management (FEDVIP brochure prepared by Metropolitan Life Insurance Company)

effective_period.quote: If you sign up for a dental and/or vision plan during the 2025 Open Season, your coverage will begin on January 1, 2026.

scope.geography: Nationwide and overseas (United States, including North Carolina) — "A Nationwide Dental PPO Plan"; "MetLife Dental is available nationwide and overseas." (cover)
scope.population: All Federal employees and annuitants in the United States and overseas who are eligible to enroll in Federal Employees Dental and Vision Insurance Program.
scope.plan_type: PPO (two options: High Option and Standard Option)
scope.network: MetLife Dental PPO (In-Network / Out-of-Network; Plan Allowance basis)

retrieval_method: WebFetch (PDF→text via a summarizing sub-model limited to ~125-character quotes; page numbers from footers of the form "2026 The MetLife Federal Dental Plan 22 Enroll at www.BENEFEDS.gov"). The converter's text window ended around pp. 29–33 in several calls, so content beyond Class C's first page (endodontics, prosthodontics, implants, Section 7 exclusions, Definitions, Rate Information p. 71) could not be verified consistently.
reuse_terms: Printed on p. 7: "Current Dental Terminology (CDT), Copyright © American Dental Association. All rights reserved." and "FEDVIP abides by the Current Dental Terminology (CDT) codification system in accordance with standards set by the American Dental Association (ADA)." No other copyright statement was visible in the extracted text; the brochure is posted by OPM (a federal agency) — treat the government-publication status as not stated in the document.
access_limits: Rate Information (printed p. 71 / back cover) was not present in the text the fetch tool returned; three attempts. Only "Your rates are determined based on where you live. This is called a rating area." and "OPM negotiates rates with each carrier annually. Rates are shown at the end of this brochure." were found. Premiums therefore UNKNOWN.

Text extraction appears truncated near p. 29–33 in several calls (one call reported the excerpt ends with "D2990 Resin infiltration of incipient smooth surface lesions - Limited"). Rows for endodontics (D3310/D3320/D3330), removable prosthodontics (D5110–D5214), implants (D6010 etc.) and occlusal guards (D9944–D9946) were reported NOT PRESENT in two verification calls; one earlier call listed such rows with descriptors that do not match CDT (e.g., "D5211 Complete denture"), so that output was treated as unreliable and discarded.
The word "waiting" was not found in two searches of the extracted text; because of the truncation this is recorded as UNKNOWN, not as 'no waiting period'.
Section 7 General Exclusions narrative (p. 50) and the Definitions entry for Plan Allowance (p. 59) were returned by one call and reported not visible by another; recorded with needs_review.

Waiting periods: no sentence containing "waiting" found in extracted text (two searches); recorded UNKNOWN because extraction was truncated.

Molar root canal (D3330), partial dentures (D5211–D5214), implant body (D6010) and occlusal guard codes (D9944–D9946/D9940): NOT PRESENT in extracted text; class, coinsurance and limits unknown. Only the 2026 change note on occlusal-guard frequency (1 in 24 months) was captured.
Section 7 General Exclusions narrative (cosmetic, missing tooth, services begun before coverage): not reliably extracted (one fetch returned only the heading at p. 50).
Family deductible: not stated in returned text (deductible printed per person).
Dependent-child age limit for fluoride: table says "based on age limits" but the limit itself was not returned.
